scenario: Discussing weekend plans with a friend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hoto fof heewi e jande eɗe eɗe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation: Hoto fof heewi eɗe eɗe e weekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.
dialogue.translation: Mi wonaa mi sooda yaha e teew, amma walu yiide heewi too many.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea! But do you have time to go with me?
dialogue.translation: Jama idea! Amma hoto fof heewi e waktu yaha e e mi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I have time because I finished my work early.
dialogue.translation: Ee, mi heewi e waktu sab mi fota miɗo eɗe eɗe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect! I think it will be a good weekend.
dialogue.translation: Dum! Mi wonaa heewi e jama weekend.

scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Aan nden, mi yiɗii ceewa nde, ammaa ɗamataa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Mi yettii kon. No yiɗii nde?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: ɗeɓe leɓɓe jooto. Mi yiɗan jowdi, si ɗon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Alaama. ɗam nde fowru eɗo. ɓe, mi yettii ma wundi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Jaraama. Mi yettii ma ceewa nde ɗaa, e mi yiɗan jowdi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Alaama. E si yettii ɗiɗi laawol, yettii no yiɗan mi.

scenario: Booking a table at a restaurant by phone

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. For how many people?
dialogue.translation: Nde, mi wonaa ɗemɗe ma?

dialogue.translation: Ma ɗemɗe fowɗe, jiiɗɗo.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll call back to confirm later.
dialogue.translation: Ee, a waɗɗata. Mi lammataaɗo jiiɗɗo a yam.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?
dialogue.translation: Nde, mi wonaa innde ma nder jiiɗɗo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.
dialogue.translation: Ee, a nder innde García.

scenario: Talking about your hometown to a visitor
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Se usa para referirse a todos los elementos de un grupo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Welcome to my hometown! It's a small place, but I love it.
dialogue.translation: Taaɗo naaɗe to maɓɓeɓe! Tooroto lugar, amma mi yiide.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! Where do you live exactly?
dialogue.translation: Jaraama! Hoto naaɗe hoto yaltude?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I live near the old church. It's very beautiful.
dialogue.translation: Mi yaltude toorondirde kadɗe jamaaɗi. To jom.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Is there a market every day?
dialogue.translation: Oo, jom! Hoto wonaaɗe suudu to ganna subaka?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I walk there every morning to buy fresh things.
dialogue.translation: Ee, amma mi yaltude to ganna subaka to sooda hakkunde jajjira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Then we can go together tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Toɗo yiide jom. Toon aɗa yaltude toɗoɓe toɓe?

scenario: Changing a reservation at a hotel

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to change my reservation for a different day.
dialogue.translation: Salama, mi yidi e jipporde e jamaare ko dii difirente.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want to come earlier or later?
dialogue.translation: Ko wale. Haa mi yidi e yahde jama ko hitaande?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Later, please. Is a room available for next week?
dialogue.translation: Hitaande, ko jama. Haɗa kam e huɗe haɗa baa laatii?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check. We have another room free after Monday.
dialogue.translation: Mi yidi e jipporde. An haɗa kam e huɗe ɓe haɗa haɗin Altine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I change my reservation to that day?
dialogue.translation: Ndeeɗa. Mi yidi e jipporde e dii ndee?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but you must confirm before Friday.
dialogue.translation: Ee, amma haa mi yidi e jipporde hakkunde Aljuma.

dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Ee, hakko en. Mi yahii dowle e waktude e waktude e waktude.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Jenngoode. Hani a yahii jooda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Mi yahii jooda waktude e waktude se mi haalaa haalaa e dowle e dowle e dowle.

key_phrases.translation: Mi yahii jooda waktude e waktude

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: General word for anything you eat
To express preference: I like + noun
To express desire; often followed by infinitive
Used in affirmative sentences with uncountable or plural nouns
General word for an object or idea
Used to intensify adjectives or verbs
In this context means 'also' at the end of a sentence

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Haa an hokki jom na'i fii jemma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Mi jom pasta, amma mi hokki wakkere hawdi fii jemma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: En en hokku jabbere e dow e ndiyam fii teewu. Ko wonaa go'oto.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Ko wonaa go'oto. Amma mi tobbere hokki hakkunde e ndiyam e wulere.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Haa an en wulitii e hokku ceen?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ko wonaa go'oto. Hoo en jom ko, e mi yidi a yi'aa ko.

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hanki a yidi aɗaɗo e jibinaama.
Hanki ɗam e maayo mawndi mawɗe e kompyuutir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: A yidi a jibinaama? Mi haɗa a ɗam kompyuutir, amma taabal mawndi toor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Ndee. Mi yidi a yiɗa. A ɗam boto toor?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Ee, mi ɗam. Amma ko ɗam. Mi yidi aɗaɗo e maayo mawndi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Mi yidi a feewa. Ko ɗam feewa e maayo mawndi feewa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Ndee, mi yidi a yiɗa. Amma ndee ko haɗa, mi haɗa feewa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Mi yidi a yiɗa. Mi yidi a yiɗa boto toor. Ah, haa! Ko ɗam feewa!

dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?

dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.

dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?

dialogue.speaker: A
